summary: Iteration 26 — Lead (Şirkət Bazası) Layihə növü, dynamic sold-fields, Projects 'Satışlar' modal, Finance 'Layihələr' tab. Backend: 8/8 pytest PASS — POST /api/sales-leads persists new fields (project_id, package, kv_m, price_per_sqm, stand_number, hall_number, total_amount, participant_count); PUT updates them; POST /api/project-events persists price_per_sqm; GET /api/project-events/{id}/sales returns {event, sales} with sector/sub_sector enrichment from companies by brand_name; invalid id → 404; only Satıldı/Üzv oldu leads returned (Yeni Tur lead excluded); scope='own' for Satış meneceri role correctly filters /project-events/{id}/sales so sales manager sees only own leads while admin sees all. Frontend: UI verified via Playwright — 'Layihə növü' column header present (was 'Satış növü'); sale_type dropdown dynamic from /api/settings/projects (options: Test, Forum 2026, Sərgi — NOT hardcoded sale_types); add-lead-btn→lead-form→lead-sale-type→lead-status-select→sold-fields all render correctly; sold-fields visible when status=Satıldı; lead-project-select visible inside sold-fields; Sərgi branch shows lead-kvm-input + lead-price-input + lead-stand-input + lead-hall-input; total auto-calc verified (kv/m 10 × price 100 = 1000); Projects page has data-testid='sales-btn-{id}' rendered per event (2 events), clicking opens Dialog with 'Satışlar' title (shows 'Bu layihə üçün satış yoxdur' when empty); Projects add-event modal event-type-select dynamic, selecting Sərgi renders event-price-input; Finance page tab-projects ('Layihələr') visible and functional, selecting Sərgi in Layihə növü selector renders matching project buttons ('Yerli şirkətlərin tanıtım sərgisi (Aktiv)').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1349 /api/project-events/{id}/sales enriches sector/sub_sector by matching lead.company_name to companies.brand_name. For non-Üzvlük leads (Sərgi/Tur/Təlim) leads are NOT promoted to companies (per requirement), so a Sərgi lead whose company name doesn't exactly match a company brand_name will get empty sector/sub_sector. Suggest also falling back on lead.sector/sub_sector if ever stored, OR denormalise these fields onto the lead at creation. Current behaviour correct per spec but fragile to typos/casing in company_name.

server.py:1292 POST /project-events does not validate price_per_sqm type. A string like '250' will pass through; frontend does handle this (Number cast) but server could coerce to float for consistent storage. Minor.

Frontend CompanyDatabase.jsx:152 handleProjectSelect auto-fills price_per_sqm only when form.price_per_sqm is falsy — if user clears value then picks a project, auto-fill works; if user types a value then switches project, manual value is preserved (intentional). Ok.
Projects.jsx: salesView Dialog uses DialogContent without accessibility description — will likely trigger React a11y warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Minor a11y only.

Finance.jsx Layihələr tab — project-type Select uses plain text-based combobox without data-testid on the trigger; minor — first combobox selector used in test worked but a dedicated testid like 'finance-project-type-select' would be more robust.
